questions.question_text: When catching a ball above your head, your fingers should point:

In Gilli-Danda, distance is often measured using the:
What should be inside a basic first-aid kit?
options: B) Bandages, antiseptic wipes, and cotton
questions.answer: B) Bandages, antiseptic wipes, and cotton

questions.question_text: Praising a peer for a good catch is an example of:
If a ball is falling fast, you should 'give' with the catch to:
options: A) Bounce it off your chest
B) Soften the impact and keep it from popping out
questions.answer: B) Soften the impact and keep it from popping out

questions.question_text: When playing with wooden sticks like in Gilli-Danda, safety means:
options: A) Swinging it near people's faces
B) Ensuring a safe clear area before striking
questions.answer: B) Ensuring a safe clear area before striking

questions.question_text: If you scrape your knee, the first thing to do is:
options: A) Ignore it and keep playing in the dirt
B) Wash it with clean water and apply an antiseptic
questions.answer: B) Wash it with clean water and apply an antiseptic

questions.question_text: How do you show you are a good team player?
options: B) Pass the ball and encourage others
questions.answer: B) Pass the ball and encourage others

questions.question_text: Why do your fingers need to point up when catching a high ball?
questions.answer: Pointing fingers up creates a basket shape and prevents the ball from hitting your face or jamming your fingers.

questions.question_text: Describe good posture when sitting at a desk.
questions.answer: Keep your back straight, shoulders relaxed, and feet flat on the ground.

questions.question_text: How is the distance measured in Gilli-Danda after a successful hit?
questions.answer: The distance from the starting hole to where the Gilli lands is measured by counting the length of the Danda.

questions.question_text: Name two items you must use to clean a small cut or scrape on the playground.
questions.answer: Clean water and an antiseptic wipe (or soap) to prevent infection.

questions.question_text: Why is it good to praise your classmates during physical education?
questions.answer: Praise builds confidence, makes the class fun, and creates a supportive team environment.

Match the catch type to the hand position: 1) High catch (above chest), 2) Low catch (below waist). Options: A) Fingers pointing down, B) Fingers pointing up.
questions.answer: 1 matches with B, 2 matches with A

questions.question_text: Your friend trips and gets a minor scrape on their hand. They are scared of the first-aid kit. What do you do?
questions.answer: I will calm them down, tell them washing it with water will help them heal faster, and walk with them to the teacher so they feel safe getting a bandage.

questions.question_text: Design a 2-minute yoga and posture routine that students can do standing next to their desks after sitting for a long time.
questions.answer: 1. Stand in Tadasana (Mountain Pose) for 30 seconds to straighten the back. 2. Reach arms high to the ceiling and stretch for 30 seconds. 3. Roll shoulders backward 10 times to release tension. 4. Take 3 deep breaths.
